name: av_balance_sheet
description:
Balance sheets (total assets, liabilities, shareholder equity, cash, debt and other line items) for one company from Alpha Vantage (BALANCE_SHEET).
Returns: {symbol, annualReports: [...], quarterlyReports: [...]}, each report with fiscalDateEnding, reportedCurrency and the line items as strings.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker). Annual and quarterly reports both come back; there is no period filter.
Related: av_income_statement, av_cash_flow; other sources: yf_balance_sheet, openbb_balance_sheet.
Example: {"symbol": "IBM"}
